source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Fuel Tank and Exhaust Systems, p.8-2

procedures.title: Fuel tank: drain by siphoning
steps: Before draining, disconnect the tank gauge unit wire or the battery negative cable.
If the car will be stored for a long time, drain the whole fuel system (carburetor, pump, all lines and tank) to prevent gum buildup and poor running.
